draft.subject: Quick hand with your first project?
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for raising the cancellation timing question with our team last week -- Tariq confirmed that a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately, and that ticket is now closed. If anything there still feels unresolved, tell me and I'll pick it up.

In the meantime, if you'd like to see what Wrenfield can do for North Partners, I'm glad to help you set up your first project this week -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Just reply and I'll walk through it with you.

Best,
Priya
